title: nf-core/gwasqc pipeline parameters
description: A pipeline for genotype array quality control

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to the comma-separated samplesheet declaring one PLINK 1 fileset per stratum.
input.help_text: You will need to create a samplesheet with one row per stratum before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with the 5 columns `id,ancestry,bed,bim,fam` and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/gwasqc/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: Genome build and reference assets the QC chain relies on.

genome_build.description: Genome build code passed to plink2 `--split-par`, which moves the chromosome X pseudo-autosomal regions to their own codes before the sex check.
genome_build.help_text: The pseudo-autosomal boundaries differ between builds, and the default long-range LD asset is GRCh38; a different build needs a matching `--high_ld_regions` file.

high_ld_regions.description: BED file of long-range linkage-disequilibrium regions whose pruned variants are excluded, together with every non-autosomal variant, from the heterozygosity and relatedness reports.
high_ld_regions.help_text: Zero-based, half-open intervals with bare chromosome codes (1-22). The default asset is derived from the legacy `highLDregions4bim_b38.awk` rules; see the file header for the derivation.

qc_threshold_options.title: QC threshold options
qc_threshold_options.description: Thresholds of the variant filter chain. Every comparison is strict, as in plink2 itself.

maf.description: Minor allele frequency threshold; variants with a frequency below this value are dropped before any other statistic is computed.

geno.description: Maximum per-variant missing-call rate; variants whose rate exceeds this value are listed for exclusion.

mind.description: Maximum per-sample missing-call rate; samples whose rate exceeds this value are listed for removal.

hwe.description: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium exact-test p-value threshold; variants with a p-value below this value are listed for exclusion.

ld_pruning_options.title: LD pruning options
ld_pruning_options.description: Parameters of the plink2 `--indep-pairwise` run that selects the variant set of the sex check, heterozygosity and relatedness reports.

ld_step_size.description: Number of variants the pruning window shifts at each step.

ld_r2.description: Pairwise r-squared above which one variant of a pair is pruned.

sample_qc_options.title: Sample QC options
sample_qc_options.description: Thresholds of the sex check and relatedness decisions, and whether their removal lists are applied to the QC'd fileset.

sex_check_max_female_xf.description: Chromosome X inbreeding coefficient F below which plink2 `--check-sex` calls a sample female.

sex_check_min_male_xf.description: Chromosome X inbreeding coefficient F above which plink2 `--check-sex` calls a sample male.

sex_check_max_female_ycount.description: Largest number of non-missing chromosome Y calls a sample called female may carry; more downgrades the call to a mismatch.

sex_check_min_male_ycount.description: Smallest number of non-missing chromosome Y calls a sample called male must carry; fewer downgrades the call to a mismatch.
sex_check_min_male_ycount.help_text: plink1.9 `--check-sex ycount` defaulted this to 0, which plink2 rejects; 1 is the smallest value plink2 accepts and the plink1.9 `y-only` default.

king_table_filter.description: Minimum KING-robust kinship coefficient a sample pair needs to be written to the relatedness table; the default is the third-degree lower bound.
king_table_filter.help_text: Pairs below the filter are absent from the table and count as unrelated in the per-individual mean kinship. Lowering it enlarges the table quadratically in the sample count.

relatedness_indiv_sd.description: Number of standard deviations above the cohort mean kinship at which an individual is listed as a mean-kinship outlier.

relatedness_po_ibs0_max.description: Largest IBS0 proportion at which a first-degree pair is classified parent-offspring rather than full sibling.
relatedness_po_ibs0_max.help_text: A parent-offspring pair shares one allele at every locus, so its IBS0 is bounded by the genotyping error rate; full sibs are IBD0 over a quarter of the genome and show IBS0 well above it.

apply_sample_removals.description: Apply the sex-mismatch and duplicate/MZ relatedness removal lists, which the legacy chain only reported, when writing the QC'd fileset; the missingness removals are always applied.
apply_sample_removals.help_text: The lists are published either way. The mean-kinship outlier list is published but never applied.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
